evidence.text: Calloway Industrial Supply has distributed bearings, power transmission parts and safety equipment since 1962. Today we serve more than 18,000 manufacturing and maintenance customers from 42 branches across the United States and Canada.
Join our outside sales organization of more than 350 territory account managers. Territory managers build quarterly account plans and quote custom orders for their customers.
Calloway announced a multi-year program to modernize how its sales teams plan territories and manage quotes, starting with a pilot in its Midwest region this fall.
